trap.label: although ... but
trap.wrong: Although it was cold, but we went out.
trap.right: Although it was cold, we went out.
trap.why: Em português, "embora... mas" é comum na fala. Em inglês, although já contrasta; não se usa but junto.

opts: Although it rained, but we left.
Although of the rain, we left.

mcq.q: Complete: **___** the traffic, he arrived early.

opts: Tom is tall despite Ben is short.
Tom is tall, whereas Ben is short.
Tom is tall although of Ben.
In spite of the cost, we bought it.
In spite the cost, we bought it.
In spite of it was costly, we bought it.

fix.wrong: Despite of the cold, we swam.
Although he was rich, but he was sad.
fix.right: Although he was rich, he was sad.

rewrite.prompt: Una com although: “It was late. We kept working.”
rewrite.answer: Although it was late, we kept working.

rewrite.prompt: Una com despite: “It was cold. We went out.” (the cold)
rewrite.answer: Despite the cold, we went out.
